description:
Young-Gil, the gangster boss who has been living a gang life for 20 years, unfortunately gets struck by lightning and falls into a coma, experiencing an out-of-body experience. Then, he hears from a dreamer he meets by chance that 'if you enter other people's dreams and gather energy, you can wake up from the coma.' So he starts looking for the dreams of his trustworthy subordinates who have been by his side...

Since when have you guys been imagining such erotic things about me?!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated) 

1-10. **Eroero Dumongnimto** (에로에로 두목님♡)
11-20. **Eroero Gwanjangnimto** (에로에로 관장님♡)
21-30. **Eroero Seonsaengnimto** (에로에로 선생님♡)
